checkpoints.description: [1/1] Ship the 2D CS-style arena shooter as an AIKit game project with headless test harness and local launcher

impact_assessment.why: User asked for the demo to live under projects/ and be AIKit-integrated rather than loose at the repository root
impact_assessment.benefits: Project memory, license, README and Phase 4 gates apply; gameplay is regression-tested without a browser
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: Node >= 20 for tests and launcher only; concurrency: none; state: files currently uncommitted
impact_assessment.mitigation: Zero browser deps, VM-based harness, static server tested for MIME and traversal

checkpoints.description: Verification complete: 7/7 node:test cases pass, 4/4 Phase 4 gates pass; checklists: passed
[1/1] Fix review findings: harden the dev server, correct the renamed title, prove bot approach, add avoidance and point-blank accuracy, gate test helpers

impact_assessment.why: Independent review of the uncommitted demo found a dot-directory leak in the dev server, a stale page title, an overclaiming test, and weaker bot pathing
impact_assessment.benefits: Loopback server no longer exposes .git/.aikit state, tests assert real behaviour, bots navigate cover instead of stalling, cheat helpers are absent in normal play
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none added; concurrency: none; state: uncommitted project files
impact_assessment.mitigation: Seeded RNG makes approach deterministic; server rules covered by node:test; all gates re-run

checkpoints.description: 10/10 node:test cases pass, 4/4 Phase 4 gates pass; checklists: passed
[1/1] Harden and extend the demo: secondary USP with semi-auto switching, persistent best score, pause/click guard, separation push-out, and broader tests

impact_assessment.why: A review pass found stale state after resets, one-weapon depth, click-queueing across pause, and bots able to be shoved into cover
impact_assessment.benefits: More CS-like loadout, a lasting score goal, deterministic state transitions, and an invariant proving bodies never rest inside walls
impact_assessment.risks: contract: snapshot gains weapon/best/slots fields; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: localStorage writes are best-effort
impact_assessment.mitigation: 14 node:test cases including a 900-frame overlap invariant; all four project gates pass

checkpoints.description: 14/14 node:test cases pass, 4/4 Phase 4 gates pass; checklists: passed
